annotations.title: Inspect a URL's Google index status

description: Runs Google Search Console URL inspection on one page of your site: index verdict, coverage, robots.txt, last crawl, user and Google canonical, plus the page's Siteiz AI readability score. Needs a Siteiz Pro API key (Authorization: Bearer header).

url.description: Full page address on one of your sites.
